main_text.p: doctrina, sed propter ecclesiasticam jurisdi-ctionem, quam habent ut persona publica & principes. Respondeat Stella in Luc. 6. in illa verba. Numquid potest cæ-cus cęcum ducere. Qui fieri potest, inquit, ut adversus hæreses disputet, qui non est theologus? quod si responderis, quod hi episcopi secum ducunt doctos theologos, qui eos illuminent & doceant, quid dicturi sint (ut in nostro concilio Tridentino nostris temporibus contigit) in hac quidem re non possum mihi a risu temperare, melius sane episcopi facerent, si episcopatus suos theologis renunciarent, de his vera est Domini sententia, si cæcus cæcū ducit &c. Definant itaque illi iurati pontificis Romani gloriari atq; imponere populo Christiano solis & inanibus titulis. Audi Paulum ad Tit. 1.8, quod episcopus & pastor sit, qui sit tenax fidelis illius sermonis qui ad doctrinam facit, ut possit & exhortari doctrina sana & contradicentes convincere. His assentitur Toletus Jes. instruct. sacerd. l. 1. cap. ult.

page.notes: Scan shows the right printed page only. The left strip is the edge of the neighbouring page. "ult." at the lower right is read as a catchword, though it may also complete the reference "cap. ult." Printed "Jes." is kept as printed. Italic lines are judged from the scan and may be imperfect. The signature "H 4" is a gathering mark at the foot.
